provenance.run: FaultLab full run, seed 42, synthetic + ESA'22 instances (F1-F6); real-data pass not yet included
provenance.use: calibrated mode only; certified bounds use no constant from this file

mergeReduceCoefficient.meaning: Var(root cost)/C^2 = coefficient * (S/m) * sum_l kappa_l; R^2 0.995; thm:martingale bounds it by 1

kappaLawPoint.meaning: per-candidate RMS / sqrt(phi kappa_pt/(1-phi)); measured 0.99-1.02 (calibration 0.991, 1.001, 1.017 over N)

kappaLawLow.meaning: lower end of the measured calibration range; reported as the calibrated band

kappaLawHigh.meaning: upper end of the measured calibration range; reported as the calibrated band

erasureSlope.meaning: measured exponent of error vs 1/(1-rho); theory (cor:loss-eps) 0.5 lies in the CI, so the model uses 0.5 and records this value only

samplingLemmaConstant.meaning: the absolute constant c of ass:sampling is not known; 1.0 normalises the UNIFORM guarantee, which is then reported in units of sqrt(c)
